# Home: what changed since you last looked

What moved since the last day Home was opened: a goal’s status on that day, by the status rule, against its status now; Home’s counts, the teams table’s last column, the Goals filter and find_goals all read the same rule.

## The rule

**The day to count from** (`sinceFor`). Home keeps, per person and workspace, the last day it was opened (`last`) and the last day before that (`prev`), behind the Prefs port under `home-seen`. Opening Home on a new day sets `prev = last`, `last = today`; again the same day changes nothing (`seenToday`). It counts from `prev` when `last` is today, else from `last`; never more than 28 days back; and when Home was never opened, from this week's Monday. (On the internal platform it is kept per person on the server, so it follows a person across devices.)

**A goal's move** (`movement`). The status on that day is the [status rule](status.md) asked with today = that day and only the check-ins posted before it (`movesSince`); a goal created on it or after has none, and no move. Then, by the status rule's rank: done now and not then, `done`; no recent update now and not then, `quiet` (weekly rhythm only); worse, `worse`; better, `better`; else none. A first status of on track is no change; a first status at risk or off track is worse. A new check-in that keeps the status is no change: Home is not a feed (History has every check-in). `early`: worse because the owner called it behind while the rules' own calculation is on track ("called early by its owner").

**The goals counted** (`changedSet`): the widest of the viewer's sets ([Home's sets](home-sets.md): Mine, My team or Watching, whichever holds most goals), so every count opens exactly those goals with `scope=` that set. With Watching switched off, the goals watched are not in it. Each goal is said with the first set it is in ("yours", "your team", "watching"), or its team's name when the set is drawn as teams. The viewer's own goals are included.

**On Home** (part 8, the side column on a computer; after the sets on a phone). Heading "Changed since {Friday 6 Nov}", "Changed this week" when never opened, "Changed in the last 4 weeks" at the cap. A line of counts, each a link to `/goals?scope={set}&moved={kind}&since={day}`: "{n} got worse", "{n} recovered", "{n} went quiet", "{n} done"; then up to four goals (`changedSince`: worse first, then quiet, better, done; each by set, then name), each with its status now (shape and word), "was {status}" and its set, and "called early by its owner" when early. More than four: "All {n} in Goals" (`&moved=any`). Nothing moved: the part is absent. A teams table's last column, "Since {Thu 5 Nov}", counts each team's moves the same way ("1 got worse", "1 recovered", "1 went quiet", or "No change"; done is not in it), each a link with `&team={id}&moved={kind}&since={day}`.

**The Goals filter.** `moved` (`worse`, `better`, `quiet`, `done`, `any`) with `since` (yyyy-mm-dd; left out or not a date: this week's Monday), written after `attention` and before the query's other parts. The filter line says "Changed since Fri 6 Nov: got worse" (recovered, went quiet, done, any change), with Remove, which takes both away. find_goals reads the same query.

## Worked examples

Each is run against the real rule by `src/spec/spec.test.ts`: the result is what the code gives.

| Given | The rule gives |
|---|---|
| On track on 6 Nov, at risk now. | `worse` |
| At risk on 6 Nov, on track now. | `better` |
| Last check-in week 44, weekly rhythm: no recent update since 9 Nov, on track before. | `quiet` |
| The same with no set rhythm. | `null` |
| On plan by the numbers; the owner called it at risk on 10 Nov. | `worse, early: called early by its owner` |
| Off track on both days, a new check-in between. | `null` |
| A goal created after the day; and one done since. | `null; done` |
| Rhea opened Home on Fri 6 Nov, and again on Tue 10 Nov at 09:00 and 15:00. | `Changed since Friday 6 Nov, both times` |
| Last opened on 2 Sep; today is 10 Nov. | `from 2026-10-13: Changed in the last 4 weeks` |
| Never opened. | `Changed this week` |
| Amara in the demo workspace on Thursday 5 Nov, last on Home on Mon 2 Nov. | `Changed since Monday 2 Nov (scope=watching): 2 recovered; first: Manual release sign-offs replaced by automated quality gates, on track, was at risk · Build & Release; Production access granted just in time, not standing, on track, was at risk · Identity & Access` |
| Rhea, the same day, never on Home before. | `Changed this week (scope=team): 1 recovered; first: Flaky tests quarantined within 24 hours, on track, was at risk · your team` |

### [src/domain/changed.test.ts](../../../src/domain/changed.test.ts)

- Home rule 5: movement › at risk on 6 Nov, on track now: better
- Home rule 5: movement › no recent update now, with a weekly rhythm: quiet; the same with no set rhythm: null
- Home rule 5: movement › on plan by the numbers, the owner called it at risk: worse, called early by its owner
- Home rule 5: movement › off track on both days, a new check-in between: null (Home is not a feed)
- Home rule 5: movement › a goal created after the day: null; done now: done; reopened: null
- Home rule 5: movement › a first status: on track is no change, at risk or off track is worse; quiet and back on track is better
- Home rule 5: sinceFor and home-seen › Rhea opened Home Fri 6 Nov and again Tue 10 Nov at 09:00 and 15:00: both visits count from 6 Nov
- Home rule 5: sinceFor and home-seen › last opened 2 Sep: counts from 28 days back, “Changed in the last 4 weeks”
- Home rule 5: sinceFor and home-seen › never opened: null, “Changed this week”, counting from the week’s Monday; first visit today: still this week
- Home rule 5: changedSince › counts by kind; rows worse first, then quiet, better and done, each by set then name
- Home rule 5: changedSince › a teams table’s “Since” column: worse, better and quiet by team; done is not in it
- Home rule 5: changedSince › counts the widest set, each goal said with the first set it is in, or its team when drawn as teams
